# Skin conductance, emotion-induction block (SIMULATED)

**Simulated recording.** `eda_emotion_task.csv` was generated by a seeded model of tonic drift
plus Bateman-shaped skin conductance responses and sensor noise, for testing analysis code.
It is not a measurement from a person.

- Sampling rate: 100 Hz, 180 s (18,000 samples)
- `time_s`: seconds from the start of the block
- `eda_us`: skin conductance in microsiemens (µS)
- `stim`: picture onset marker on its first sample — 1 = neutral picture, 2 = negative
  picture, 0 otherwise (12 pictures, one every ~14 s)
